The '''Vorkutan Labor Crisis''' was a labor and municipal crisis in [[Vorkutangrad]] from 1924 to 1926.

Old source material describes the crisis as the moment when worker assemblies began taking control of city districts and industrial zones. Under [[Marina Volkhova]], those assemblies evolved into the first city kollektivy associated with [[Gorodovaya Syndikalizm]].

== Significance ==

The crisis turned [[Viktor Zheleznyakov]]'s 1923 theory into practical political organization. It helped transform Gorodovaya Syndikalizm from a critique of industrial planning into a governing model for factories, neighborhoods, transport, and public services.

The source does not provide a full conflict chronology, so this draft avoids specifying battles, casualties, police repression, or final treaty terms.
